text.p: Following are the reports carried by Estonia's newspapers on Friday. Reuters has not verified these reports and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Security police have arrested a suspect in connection with a bomb blast that wrecked a residential building in Tallinn on Thursday, injuring three residents.
- FIFA ruled the football game between Estonia and Scotland will be replayed.

- Prime Minister Tiit Vahi expects Foreign Minister Siim Kallas to explain why he agreed with Russian Foreign Minister Yevgeni Primakov on Tuesday to form a commission to investigate the living conditions of Russian-speakers in Estonia.
- President Lennart Meri appointed former Foreign Minister Juri Luik Estonia's ambassador to the Netherlands.
- A business man importing a popular energy drink to Estonia is exposed as a convicted criminal, who attempted a bank fraud in 1995.
- The INREKO shipping Co has mortgaged three hydrofoils to Merita Bank and negotiations for extending the loan term have been delayed.
